messages:
sam: Heads up 1: change window tonight 23:00-01:00 UTC. Freeze 22:50-01:30. Planning a small rollout: v1.13.0-performance.

nina: Acknowledged. Any pinning required?

sam: Pin image sha256:cc7a... and reserve dedicated-pool=us-central-2 for this push. No DB migrations.

release-coord: Preflight checklist:
  - feature-flag ff_perf=true (set)
  - smoke tests=green (staging)
  - rollback-owner=nina
  - fallback=v1.12.9

deploy-bot: Schedule: env=prod, version=v1.13.0-performance, mode=canary, steps=[5,25,60,100], start=3805554321

sre-oncall: SLO watch ready. Alerts: 5xx>0.5% OR p95>750ms -> page. Smoke scripts standing by.

nina: Adding auto-fallback rule now.

deploy-bot: Auto-fallback rule set: fallback_version=v1.12.9, trigger=(5xx>0.5% for 5m) OR (p95>750ms for 5m), action=rollback.

sam: Quick note: traffic-shift set to gradual-10m steps. Keep manual hold at 25% for 15m observe.

deploy-bot: Canary progressing: 5% -> 25%. Safety-hold at 25% enabled.

sre-oncall: Initial tail checks: p95=140ms, errors=0.02%. No issues so far.

sam: Proceed to 60% after 15m soak if no alerts.

[15m pass]

deploy-bot: Manual approval received from sam. Advancing to 60%.

sre-oncall: Noticing slight uptick in 5xx on /embed endpoint (0.6%). Investigating traces.

nina: I'm seeing OOM restarts on one replica in us-central-2. If it hits >2 pods in 5m we'll roll back.

deploy-bot: Alert: oom_restarts=3 across pool in 4m. Trigger conditions matched. Notifying rollback owner nina.

nina: Executing rollback to v1.12.9 now: /deploy rollback --env prod --to v1.12.9 --confirm --reason "oom spike"

deploy-bot: Rollback started by nina. Est. duration 180s.

sre-oncall: Watching pod stabilisation. Error rate decreasing. p95 trending back to baseline.

sam: Thanks. Keep v1.12.9 pinned and schedule a follow-up RCA. We'll reschedule the rollout after patch.

release-coord: Release notes updated with rollback notice and next steps. Meeting tomorrow 10:00 PT for triage.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: status=success, final_version=v1.12.9, completed_at=3805554380
